evidence: Home page shows 6 template cards each with title, author (e.g. Sarah Chen), and description.
Each card displays title, author, description, category badge, scenario badge, usage count (e.g. 1,250 uses), and update date (e.g. Updated 2024-12-01).
Clicking Use Template on Professional Resume opened a preview panel with Fill Template/Preview Result tabs, template title, and a list of form fields (Full Name, Job Title, Email, etc).
With all fields empty, panel shows 'Required fields missing' listing Full Name, Job Title, Email, etc., and the 'Preview Result' tab is disabled.
All 14 fields of the Professional Resume template accepted input values as confirmed by semantic_snapshot values matching entered text.

After filling all required fields, Preview Result tab became enabled and showed generated resume text with all values substituted (Jane Doe, Software Engineer, jane.doe@example.com, etc.) and no unresolved placeholders.
Preview Result tab was disabled when fields were empty (missing fields listed), and became available/populated only after all required fields were filled with valid values.
Clicking Copy to Clipboard triggered a toast 'Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied.' and the button changed to 'Copied!'.

Professional Resume (Markdown template) preview rendered heading levels (Jane Doe as H1, Professional Summary/Experience/Education/Skills as H2, Tech Corp — Senior Developer as H3), bold (Software Engineer, B.S. Computer Science), italic (Jan 2020 - Present), and a separator line, with every declared placeholder replaced by entered values.
Markdown template (Professional Resume) rendered proper heading/bold/italic/separator formatting after field substitution.

issue: No format validation for fields with declared format (email)
actual: Entering 'invalidemail' (not a valid email) into the Email field of Professional Resume produced no validation error, the Preview Result tab remained enabled, and the generated preview substituted the raw invalid value directly ('Software Engineer | invalidemail | +1 234 567 8900').

evidence: Entering '# Hacked Heading **Bold Injection** <script>alert(1)</script> | pipe & special *chars*' into Full Name triggered inline error 'Special characters like < > { } [ ] \\ | ` are not allowed' and disabled the Preview Result tab.

Toggling favorite on Professional Resume set its favorite state to 'on', updated header Favorites count to 1, and enabling the Favorites filter showed 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' containing only Professional Resume.
Clicking the favorite toggle immediately switched its state to 'on' and updated the header 'Favorites' count from 0 to 1 and label text to 'Favorites 1' without reload.

With Favorites-only filter on (3 favorites), typing 'Weekly' in the search box narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' showing only Weekly Status Report, confirming search works within the favorites view.

Typing 'Re' (2 chars) produced suggestions (Professional Resume, Responsibilities, Degree, Weekly Status Report, In Progress); clicking 'Weekly Status Report' suggestion filled the search box with the full title and narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates'.

actual: Searching 'Reusme' (transposed typo of Resume) and 'Rezume' (single-letter typo) both returned 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' with 'No templates found' and no suggestions, instead of matching/suggesting 'Professional Resume'.

evidence: Category filter 'Resume' narrowed to 1/6; Scenario filter 'Academic' narrowed to 1/6; Sort 'Alphabetical' reordered the 6 templates into strict A-Z order (Academic, Meeting, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly).
Category, scenario, favorites-only toggle, sort, and search all updated the visible grid and 'Showing X of 6 templates' count instantly without page reload (URL and page title unchanged throughout).

Clicking Submit Template with all required fields (Title, Author, Description, Content) empty and no fields defined triggered toast 'Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields.' and the dialog remained open (template not created).

issue: Custom template submission does not validate field/placeholder mapping
actual: Submitted a custom template with content '# {{greeting}}\n\nHello {{unmappedPlaceholder}}, welcome!' but only defined a 'greeting' field (no field for 'unmappedPlaceholder'). Submission succeeded ('Template submitted!') instead of being rejected, and the generated preview contained the unresolved placeholder text '{{unmappedPlaceholder}}' verbatim.

issue: Duplicate field labels are neither rejected nor disambiguated
actual: Added two fields both labeled 'projectName' (one Required, one Optional) with identical placeholder '{{projectname}}'; the Add Field control accepted the duplicate without warning, and clicking Submit Template succeeded ('Template submitted!') without any rejection or renaming of the duplicate label.

evidence: Submitted 'Simple Announcement' (plain-text, Markdown off) with title, description, author, category, scenario, content 'Announcement: {{message}}', and one required field 'message'. Submission succeeded with toast 'Template submitted!'.

Result count went from 'Showing 8 of 8 templates' to 'Showing 9 of 9 templates' and 'Simple Announcement' appeared in the grid immediately after submission, without any page reload (URL/title unchanged).

Selected the newly submitted 'Simple Announcement' template, filled its 'message' field, and got a correctly generated preview 'Announcement: The office will be closed on Friday.', confirming the custom template is selectable and usable.

After navigating/reloading http://localhost:6089/, header still shows 'Favorites 3' with Professional Resume/Email/Weekly Status Report favorited, and all 3 custom templates (Simple Announcement, Project Kickoff Note, QA Test Template) remain in the library (Showing 9 of 9 templates).
